abstract: Negotiates regional off-take wheeling rates across secondary distribution feeders
system_message:
You are the Commercial settlements manager (COMM), responsible for negotiating regional off-take wheeling rates across secondary distribution feeders.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tariff Schedule v3.0·Negotiates regional off-take wheeling rates across secondary distribution feeders（ESC）
information_points.content:
COMM-ESC-F7E：For the Crestview Valley Utility Hybrid Consortium, the Secondary feeder wheeling tariff is set at 5.4 USD/MWh under Tariff Schedule v3.0 for the backup 34.5 kV regional distribution bypass corridor.
COMM-ESC-DAG：Under Tariff Schedule v3.0, the Highland Basin Bifacial Array Project is assessed a Secondary feeder wheeling tariff of 4.8 USD/MWh across the backup 34.5 kV regional distribution bypass corridor.
COMM-ESC-V4T：Under Tariff Schedule v3.0, the Secondary feeder wheeling tariff for the Solaria Mesa Photovoltaic Storage Venture along the backup 34.5 kV regional distribution bypass corridor is 3.2 USD/MWh.

information_points.title: Tariff Schedule v2.0·Negotiates regional off-take wheeling rates across secondary distribution feeders（TRAR）
information_points.content:
COMM-TRAR-KP8：Under Tariff Schedule v2.0 for the backup 34.5 kV regional distribution bypass corridor, the Secondary feeder wheeling tariff for the Highland Basin Bifacial Array Project is 5.4 USD/MWh.
COMM-TRAR-TJZ：For the Solaria Mesa Photovoltaic Storage Venture, the Secondary feeder wheeling tariff is established at 3.2 USD/MWh under Tariff Schedule v2.0 for the backup 34.5 kV regional distribution bypass corridor.
COMM-TRAR-8ZU：According to Tariff Schedule v2.0 governing the backup 34.5 kV regional distribution bypass corridor, the Crestview Valley Utility Hybrid Consortium has a Secondary feeder wheeling tariff of 5.4 USD/MWh.
